faqs.question: Does Custom Swag Factory (Jinjiang Naike Promo Co., Ltd.) hold a valid SEDEX 4-Pillar audit?
faqs.answer: Yes. Jinjiang Naike Promo Co., Ltd. holds an active, valid SEDEX 4-Pillar audit (SMETA 6.1 protocol, Sedex Reference ID: ZC41920847) audited by SGS with zero critical non-compliances across all 4 pillars: Labor Standards, Health & Safety, Environment, and Business Ethics. B2B buyers can link directly with our facility on the Sedex Advance platform or request the full unredacted PDF audit report.

faqs.question: What is the difference between a SEDEX 2-Pillar and a valid SEDEX 4-Pillar audit for corporate swag sourcing?
faqs.answer: While a 2-Pillar SMETA audit only covers Labor Standards and Health & Safety, our valid SEDEX 4-Pillar audit additionally verifies Pillar 3 (Environmental Management: closed-loop water recycling, VOC emission control, and GRS recycled material traceability) and Pillar 4 (Business Ethics: anti-bribery compliance and strict client IP/mold NDA security). Most Fortune 500 enterprises and European retail chains mandate a valid SEDEX 4-Pillar audit for vendor onboarding.

faqs.question: Besides the valid SEDEX 4-Pillar audit, what other factory audits and brand authorizations do you hold?
faqs.answer: Our 1,650 m² Jinjiang manufacturing facility holds amfori BSCI Grade A (DBID: 394218), Disney FAMA (Facility and Merchandise Authorization ID: W128-4829-1), Coca-Cola SGP (Green Tier), McDonald's SWA, ISO 9001:2015 (04124Q1089R0M), ISO 14001:2015 (04124E2093R0M), and Global Recycled Standard GRS 4.0 (CU1094821).

faqs.question: Are your custom shoe charms, lapel pins, plush toys, and corporate swag kits compliant with US CPSIA, Prop 65, and EU EN71?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every batch is manufactured using 100% eco-friendly, phthalate-free and lead-free materials verified by SGS and Intertek. Our products pass US CPSIA Section 101 & 108 (Lead < 10 ppm, 8P Phthalates ND < 50 ppm), California Proposition 65, EU EN71-1/2/3 (including 15kg/147N rivet pull testing), EU REACH SVHC, and FDA 21 CFR / German LFGB food-contact tests.

faqs.question: What are your minimum order quantities (MOQ) and production lead times for audited custom swag?
faqs.answer: Our factory-direct MOQ starts at 100 pieces for custom PVC shoe charms, enamel pins, medals, and challenge coins, and 50–100 sets for curated corporate onboarding swag boxes. We deliver free 3D CAD mockups within 12 hours, physical samples in 3–5 days, and bulk production in 7–14 days.
